UOzAU0hoIFzQ4fTrDTmsgA.zh: WHO於今年9/14宣布智利消除犬隻傳播的人類狂犬病,為南美洲第一個認證的國家。該國⻑期推動犬隻疫苗接種、疫情監測、實驗室診斷及暴露後預防處置(PEP)等措施,已超過50年未發生案例。依WHO消除認證標準,要求至少連續2年無相關人類死亡病例,並具備完善公衛監測、實驗室診斷、犬隻疫苗接種及暴露後預防處置(PEP)等因應整備能力。 馬來西亞西北部吉打州古邦巴素縣報告1名31歲男性死亡案例,為該縣自1998年以來首例人類病例。 個案於8月被流浪狗咬傷後就醫,未接受暴露後預防(PEP),相關部門已採取預防措施,並進行流行病學調查,以確定感染來源。
UOzAU0hoIFzQ4fTrDTmsgA.en: On 14 September this year, WHO declared Chile free of dog-mediated human rabies, the first country in South America to be certified. The country has long promoted dog vaccination, surveillance, laboratory diagnosis and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and has gone more than 50 years without cases. Under WHO elimination certification criteria, a country must have no related human deaths for at least two consecutive years and must have adequate public health surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, dog vaccination and PEP capacity. In north-western Malaysia, in Kubang Pasu district of Kedah state, a 31-year-old man has died of rabies, the first human case in the district since 1998. He was bitten by a stray dog in August, sought medical care, but did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis. Authorities have taken preventive measures and are conducting an epidemiological investigation to identify the source of infection.

HMPvbd-gh0VZUXrxUt4VPA.zh: 菲律賓宿霧省(Cebu)疫情上升,今年截至8/18累計報告2,324例病例,其中17例死亡,自7月進入雨季以來積水增加,致疫情顯著上升;鄰近之薄荷省(Bohol)亦爆發疫情,今年截至8/22累計報告1,883例病例,較去年同期增加7%,已至少20例死亡,致死率(CFR:1.17%)已超過該國設定之流行閾(1%),且全省12 個行政區已連續3週逾流行閾,疫情以塔利邦(Talibon)、塔比拉蘭(Tagbilaran City)及烏拜(Ubay)最為嚴重,當局已宣佈進入疫情警示。 馬來西亞疫情快速上升,今年迄今累計報告逾6.2萬例病例,其中60例死亡,疫情較去年同期增加60%。當局已啟動應變中,於吉隆坡與雪蘭莪州(Selangor )等熱點部署,擴大釋放沃爾巴克氏菌(Wolbachia)轉染的蚊子以進行生物防治,並進行登革熱疫苗成本效益分析,評估可能納入國家常規疫苗接種計畫。 印度今年截至7月累計報告3萬3,060例病例,與去年同期相當,其中7月新增1萬122例,較6月增加53%。該國病例通常於每年5-6月(季風雨季開始)呈現上升趨勢,並在9-10月達到全年高峰。 歐洲今年截至8/5僅有法國報告4例本土病例。研究顯示因為氣候變遷因素,2015-24年歐洲的疫情發生風險,為1982-2010年的3倍。
HMPvbd-gh0VZUXrxUt4VPA.en: In Cebu Province, Philippines, dengue is rising: as of 18 August this year, 2,324 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17 deaths; standing water has increased since the rainy season began in July, causing a marked rise. Neighbouring Bohol Province has also had an outbreak: as of 22 August this year, 1,883 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7% more than the same period last year, with at least 20 deaths. The case fatality rate (1.17%) exceeds the country's epidemic threshold (1%), and 12 administrative areas across the province have exceeded the threshold for three consecutive weeks; the outbreak is most serious in Talibon, Tagbilaran City and Ubay. Authorities have declared an outbreak alert. Malaysia's outbreak is rising rapidly: as of this year, more than 62,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 60 deaths, 60% more than the same period last year. Authorities have activated a response and are deploying hotspot measures in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, expanding the release of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes for biological control, and conducting a cost-effectiveness analysis of a dengue vaccine to assess whether it could be included in the national routine vaccination programme. India reported 33,060 cases cumulatively through July this year, similar to the same period last year; 10,122 were added in July, 53% more than in June. Cases in India usually rise from May to June, at the start of the monsoon rains, and reach an annual peak in September–October. In Europe, as of 5 August this year, only France had reported 4 locally acquired cases. Studies show that climate change has made the risk of dengue outbreaks in Europe during 2015–24 three times that of 1982–2010.

ZkxTRUH9crFJXnTG3SWl2g.zh: 馬來西亞今年截至8/22累計報告5萬8,079例病例,其中55例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加56.2%,疫情主要集中於中部雪蘭莪州(Selangor),報告逾2.5萬例,吉隆坡等地疫情亦上升。當局表示天氣變化造成疫情攀升,已啟動早期病例偵測及病媒蚊防治等措施,另因自費價偏高且宣導不足,登革熱疫苗接種率處低點。 孟加拉疫情持續上升,今年截至8/22累計報告2萬8,090例住院病例,其中77例死亡,疫情高於去年同期,且8月疫情較7月增幅高。目前部分醫院專責病房已滿載,多數患者入院時已有血壓下降及休克等併發症,當局表示近期間歇性降雨有利於病媒蚊孳生,加上全國蚊媒防治措施未達預期,預期疫情將持續攀升至10月。
ZkxTRUH9crFJXnTG3SWl2g.en: Malaysia reported 58,079 cases cumulatively as of 22 August this year, including 55 deaths; cases are 56.2% higher than in the same period last year. The outbreak is concentrated in Selangor state in central Malaysia, which has reported more than 25,000 cases, and cases are also rising in Kuala Lumpur and other areas. Authorities say weather changes have driven the rise; early case detection and vector mosquito control measures have been launched. Uptake of dengue vaccination is at a low point because the out-of-pocket price is high and awareness is inadequate. Bangladesh's epidemic continues to rise: as of 22 August this year, 28,090 hospitalised cases have been reported cumulatively, including 77 deaths. The epidemic is higher than the same period last year, and the increase in August was larger than in July. Some hospital dedicated wards are now full, and most patients already had complications such as falling blood pressure and shock on admission. Authorities say recent intermittent rain favours mosquito breeding and that nationwide vector control measures have not met expectations; they expect the outbreak to keep rising into October.

kFSGKEanfINbxyHiYCvuuQ.zh: 馬來西亞今年截至8/11累計報告5萬5,855例病例,其中死亡49 例,已超越2025年全年病例數(5萬5,399例)。該國過往主要流行型別為DENV-2型,惟今年DENV-3型已構成威脅,過往曾感染DENV-2型之⺠眾對於DENV-3型不但未具保護力,反而更容易引發重症,當局評估聖嬰現象之高溫將導致疫情持續上升,惟評估應不會達到2023及2024年之12萬例高峰。 美國南部佛羅里達州坦帕灣(Tampa Bay)地區爆發本土疫情,近日累計報告10例本土確定病例,該州南部之邁阿密戴德郡(Miami-Dade)及棕櫚灘郡(Palm Beach)亦報告本土病例。
kFSGKEanfINbxyHiYCvuuQ.en: Malaysia reported 55,855 cases cumulatively this year as of 11 August, including 49 deaths, already exceeding the full-year total for 2025 (55,399 cases). Malaysia's main circulating serotype has previously been DENV-2, but this year DENV-3 has posed a threat; people previously infected with DENV-2 have no protection against DENV-3 and are in fact more prone to severe disease. Authorities assess that high temperatures associated with El Niño will keep the epidemic rising, but assess that it should not reach the peak of 120,000 cases seen in 2023 and 2024. In the Tampa Bay area of southern Florida, USA, a local outbreak has occurred; 10 locally acquired confirmed cases have recently been reported cumulatively. Locally acquired cases have also been reported in Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties in southern Florida.

f48vuX3YKe8UqBCyr2d1tw.zh: 馬來西亞疫情上升,今年截至6/13累計報告33,367例病例,較去年同期27,640例上升27%,病例數以雪蘭莪州15,422例最多。該國今年已報告23例死亡,較去年同期17例死亡上升35%,目前主要流行型別為DENV-3。 孟加拉疫情更新,最近24小時內新增60例病例,今年截至6/20 累計4,680例病例及7例死亡,病例數以巴里薩爾市1,243例為多,該國近期疫情遽升,自6月迄今病例數1,483例,為5月病例數(714例)的2倍,且以男性為多(62.9%)。
f48vuX3YKe8UqBCyr2d1tw.en: Malaysia's outbreak is rising. As of 13 June this year, 33,367 cases have been reported cumulatively, 27% higher than the 27,640 cases in the same period last year. Selangor State has the most cases, with 15,422. Malaysia has reported 23 deaths this year, 35% higher than the 17 deaths in the same period last year. The main circulating serotype is DENV-3. Bangladesh's outbreak update: in the past 24 hours, 60 new cases were added, and as of 20 June this year, 4,680 cases and 7 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Barisal City has the most cases, with 1,243. The outbreak in Bangladesh has recently surged: cases since June total 1,483, twice the 714 cases reported in May, and male cases predominate (62.9%).

D0sEc2_hBlI36Qgg3M34pw.zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越報告今年第3例病例,為古晉市10歲男童,2/11遭流浪犬咬傷後僅清洗傷口,於3月初開始出現症狀,經住院治療後於3/18死亡。該州今年截至3/14累計報告4,623例遭動物咬傷病例,其中遭貓咬傷病例數上升,已多於流浪犬咬傷之病例。
D0sEc2_hBlI36Qgg3M34pw.en: Sarawak, Malaysia, reported its third case this year: a 10-year-old boy from Kuching City who was bitten by a stray dog on 11 February and only washed the wound. Symptoms appeared in early March, and after hospital treatment he died on 18 March. As of 14 March, the state has reported 4,623 cumulative animal-bite cases this year; cat-bite cases have risen and now exceed dog-bite cases.

o9POBpZkvyvf-QiettY_fw.zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州報告1例死亡病例,為51歲男性,未曾被動物抓咬傷,僅於今(2025)年6月處理過未接種疫苗之寵物狗屍體,病患於10/8起陸續出現發燒、手部麻木及關節痛等症狀,9日至診所就醫,18日出現虛弱及脫水現象,經實驗室確診。該州今年累計報告6例死亡病例,當局表示67.5%之咬傷事件來自家中寵物,提醒寵物應每年接種疫苗,倘被犬/貓/寵物抓咬傷,應立即以清水及肥皂清洗傷口至少15分鐘,並立即就醫,如發現犬/貓/動物死亡,勿自行處理,應向當地政府通報。
o9POBpZkvyvf-QiettY_fw.en: Sarawak state, Malaysia, reported one death: a 51-year-old man with no known animal bites or scratches, who had handled the carcass of an unvaccinated pet dog in June this year. He began having fever, hand numbness and joint pain from 8 October, visited a clinic on the 9th, and on the 18th developed weakness and dehydration. Laboratory testing confirmed rabies. So far this year, the state has reported six deaths. Authorities say 67.5% of bite incidents involve pets at home, and remind owners to vaccinate pets every year. If a person is bitten or scratched by a dog, cat or other pet, the wound should be washed with clean water and soap for at least 15 minutes and medical care sought immediately. If a dead dog, cat or other animal is found, do not handle it yourself; report it to the local government.

sm6D6nUjZRi4Rl1MNVt1Gw.zh: 日本第40週(9/29-10/5) 流感定點門診平均病例數1.56例,已連續4週上升,該國於10/3宣布進入流感季,以沖繩縣12.18例為多,有36個都道府縣病例數較前1週上升。專家表示今年疫情爆發較往年時間略早,惟現在天氣未如冬季氣溫低且乾燥,現階段不太可能爆發大規模疫情,然仍須留意疫情發展,並做好防護措施。 泰國疫情爆發,今年迄今累計報告超過70萬例,其中65例死亡,多數病例為老年人及兒童,以5-9歲兒童為多,死亡病例以60歲以上族群為多。由於該國雨季結束,天氣轉涼增加呼吸道感染風險,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗並避免前往人口密集場所。 馬來西亞第40週報告97起流感群聚事件,較前1週14起大幅上升,當局表示該國所有州之群聚事件均增加,其中以雪蘭莪州(43起)為多,其次為吉隆坡/布城(15起),多數為教育機構,約有6,000名學生感染。該國定點診所監測顯示,類流感病例數增加,第39週至第40週由5.95%上升至7.38%,型別以A(H3)流感為主。
sm6D6nUjZRi4Rl1MNVt1Gw.en: Japan: In week 40 (29 September–5 October), the average number of influenza cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 1.56, rising for four consecutive weeks. Japan declared the start of its flu season on 3 October. Okinawa Prefecture had the highest figure, at 12.18, and 36 prefectures saw an increase from the previous week. Experts say this year's outbreak began somewhat earlier than in past years, but current weather is not as cold and dry as in winter, so a large-scale outbreak is unlikely at this stage; developments should nevertheless be monitored and protective measures taken. Thailand: An outbreak has occurred. So far this year, more than 700,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 65 died. Most cases are older adults and children, with the largest number among children aged 5–9, and most deaths are among people over 60. Because the rainy season has ended and the weather is turning cooler, the risk of respiratory infection has increased, and authorities urge people to get vaccinated and avoid crowded places. Malaysia: In week 40, 97 influenza cluster incidents were reported, a sharp increase from 14 the previous week. Authorities say cluster incidents rose in all states, with the most in Selangor (43), followed by Kuala Lumpur/Putrajaya (15). Most were in educational institutions, and about 6,000 students were infected. Sentinel clinic surveillance shows that influenza-like illness cases rose from 5.95% in weeks 39 to 40 to 7.38%, with type A(H3) predominant.

fof-IfGNy0NJKQWfZLn2-A.zh: 馬來西亞砂拉越州報告2例死亡病例,案1為22歲女學生,曾於7月被流浪貓抓傷,未就醫進行治療,9/8出現發燒、身體無力及吞嚥困難等症狀,19日死亡;案2為67歲女性,8/30曾被犬隻咬傷,9/13出現發燒、行為改變及飲水困難等症狀,16日就醫,19日死亡,另病患飼養4隻寵物皆未接種疫苗,其中一隻曾出現狂犬病症狀死亡;該州自2017年迄今已累計報告87例,其中80例死亡(CFR:92%),今(2025)年累計報告4例,當局提醒民眾倘被犬貓抓咬傷,應立即以清水及肥皂清洗傷口至少15分鐘並立即就醫,另倘發現犬/貓/動物死亡,勿自行處理,應向當地政府通報。
fof-IfGNy0NJKQWfZLn2-A.en: Sarawak State, Malaysia reported two fatal cases. Case 1 was a 22-year-old female student who had been scratched by a stray cat in July and did not seek treatment; she developed fever, physical weakness and difficulty swallowing on 8 September and died on 19 September. Case 2 was a 67-year-old woman who was bitten by a dog on 30 August; she developed fever, behavioural changes and difficulty drinking water on 13 September, sought medical care on 16 September and died on 19 September. The patient kept four pets, none of which had been vaccinated; one of them had shown rabies symptoms and died. Since 2017 the state has cumulatively reported 87 cases, of which 80 were fatal (CFR: 92%); four cases have been reported so far in 2025. Authorities remind the public that if bitten or scratched by a dog or cat, wounds should be washed immediately with clean water and soap for at least 15 minutes, and medical care sought right away. If a dead dog, cat or other animal is found, do not handle it oneself; report it to the local government.

KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告逾360萬例病例及2,000例死亡,以美洲地區報告逾330萬例病例為多,其中病例主要分布於巴西;今年亞洲地區之印累計89,845例病例、馬來西亞35,348例、斯里蘭卡31,544例、越南28,787例、泰國24,372例及孟加拉20,218例;非洲地區累計10國報告9,266例病例及18例死亡。
KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.en: Globally, more than 3.6 million cases and 2,000 deaths have been cumulatively reported this year, with the Americas region accounting for more than 3.3 million cases, mainly in Brazil. In Asia this year, Indonesia has cumulatively reported 89,845 cases, Malaysia 35,348, Sri Lanka 31,544, Viet Nam 28,787, Thailand 24,372 and Bangladesh 20,218. In Africa, 10 countries have reported 9,266 cases and 18 deaths cumulatively.

v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第22週(5/26-6/1)全球陽性率3.5%,除非洲、西太平洋及東地中海區以外,餘區域陽性率皆上升。 馬來西亞疫情上升,5月下旬每日新增300例病例,較去年12月高峰為高,住院數亦上升,陽性率達68%;韓國疫情經4月高峰後,呈波動下降趨勢,第24週(6/8-14)新增93例病例,為第10週以來最低,陽性率為9.9%,以NB.1.8.1為主;日本第24週(6/9-15)定點平均報告數0.90例,較前一週0.92例下降,自年初以來,疫情持續下降;越南胡志明市疫情經4-5月高峰後,呈下降趨勢,第24週(6/9-15)報告32例,較前2週下降66%;香港第24週(6/8-14)陽性率4.89%,陽性率及定醫就診率持續呈下降趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,以NB.1.8.1為主要流行變異株。 美國疫情下降,自1月初每週1,000例死亡,下降至5月每週200例,第20週(5/11-17)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比最高,預測NB.1.8.1將成為主流變異株;加拿大疫情處低點,病例數自1月之每週近4,000例,下降至5月每週約500例,第22週(5/25-31)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比為高。  歐洲11國處疫情高點,第23週(6/1-7)門診陽性率10.2%,較前週高峰(10.9%)稍低,惟住院陽性率達5.9%,為今年新高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢;以NB.1.8.1變異株占比最高,LP.8.1占比次高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.en: Epidemic update: In week 22 of 2025 (26 May–1 June), global positivity was 3.5%, with increases in all regions except Africa, the Western Pacific and the Eastern Mediterranean. Malaysia: the epidemic is rising. Daily new cases were about 300 in late May, higher than the December peak; hospitalizations are also rising, and positivity reached 68%. South Korea: after a peak in April, the epidemic has fluctuated and declined. In week 24 (8–14 June), 93 new cases were reported, the lowest since week 10, with positivity of 9.9%, mainly NB.1.8.1. Japan: in week 24 (9–15 June) the sentinel average was 0.90, down from 0.92 the previous week, and the epidemic has continued to decline since the beginning of the year. Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: after a peak in April–May, the epidemic is declining; 32 cases were reported in week 24 (9–15 June), down 66% over the previous two weeks. Hong Kong: in week 24 (8–14 June), positivity was 4.89%. Positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates continue to decline, and wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 as the main circulating variant. United States: the epidemic is declining. Deaths fell from about 1,000 per week in early January to about 200 per week in May. Positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest shares; NB.1.8.1 is predicted to become the dominant variant. Canada: the epidemic is at a low point. Weekly cases fell from nearly 4,000 in January to about 500 in May. Positivity in week 22 (25–31 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for high shares. Europe: 11 countries are at the epidemic peak. Outpatient positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 10.2%, slightly lower than the previous peak of 10.9%, but hospital positivity reached 5.9%, the highest this year. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest share and LP.8.1 the second highest. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

o873ur_A3pgZQT2TBbr2zQ.en: Epidemic update: in week 19 of 2025 (5–11 May), the global positivity rate was about 3%, with more significant increases in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and South-East Asia regions. WHO reports that the global outbreak has risen significantly since February this year, and recent positivity rates are approaching last July's peak. The share of the LP.8.1 variant has declined since mid-April, while the share of NB.1.8.1 has risen to 10.7% in mid-May. WHO assesses that the current global risk remains high, although public health risk has not so far been affected by the variants under monitoring. In weeks 17–20 (20 April–17 May), positivity in Singapore rose from 13% to 20%; in Australia it rose from 2.4% to 3%, with XEC and LP.8.1 the most prevalent variants; in Malaysia, positivity in weeks 15–18 continued to rise, from 8% to 24%, with at least 110 cases reported daily. Hong Kong's positivity in week 21 was 11.1%, lower than the previous week (13.8%). The outbreak remains at a high level but has begun to decline, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also fallen; wastewater and respiratory sample surveillance show NB.1.8.1 as the most prevalent variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions, and the LP.8.1 variant still accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.
